birds.title: Meet Birds.
birds.intro: Our first inhabitants call from the trees. A dry, low chirp may open into repeated calls or a quick, canary-like phrase. Their voices are made with FM synthesis.

controls.name: Level
controls.text: Bring Birds closer in the mix, or let them settle behind the other inhabitants.

controls.name: Species
controls.text: Explore the voice’s register and character. Turn left for lower calls, right for higher ones. The centre-marked dial makes this direction visible.

controls.name: Cycle
controls.text: Choose the cycle Birds will follow in Tame mode. In Wild, their timing is free.

controls.name: Wild / Tame
controls.text: Wild lets them wander in time. Tame gives their appearances a musical grid, following the global clock.

birds.tryit: Lower the other families for a moment. Move Species slowly, then switch to Tame and compare a short cycle with an uneven one. Leave a little space between each change.
birds.extra: Species and phrasing are different dimensions. Moving into a higher register does not simply select a different fixed recording. The small speech bubble follows the creature’s activity.
birds.label: Birds

insects.title: Small voices, intricate rhythms.
insects.intro: Insects live closer to the ground: buzzing, ticking and rubbing tiny textures into the spaces between the other calls.

controls.name: Level
controls.text: Set how clearly the insects sit in the scene.

controls.name: Species
controls.text: Move through lower to higher insect registers, from left to right.

controls.name: Cycle
controls.text: In Tame, choose their own cycle. Birds and Insects can follow different cycles on the same clock.

controls.name: Wild / Tame
controls.text: Let their entrances roam freely, or invite them onto the rhythmic grid.

insects.tryit: Keep Birds gentle and give Insects an uneven Tame cycle. Listen for the places where their rhythms meet.
insects.extra: Use ALGO to move between Birds, Insects and Water. From Home, ALGO opens the family editor; within it, ALGO changes the family.
insects.label: Insects

water.title: Listen below the surface.
water.intro: Water brings rounded plops, bubbling gestures and low, frog-like calls. It is another inhabitant of the island, separate from the continuous Ocean Tide.

controls.name: Level
controls.text: Set the presence of Water’s events.

controls.name: Species
controls.text: Move from lower, rounder voices towards higher watery calls.

controls.name: Cycle
controls.text: Set Water’s Tame cycle independently of the other families.

controls.name: Wild / Tame
controls.text: Choose free timing or a relationship with the global rhythm.

water.tryit: Bring Water forward and move Species slowly. Then add a quiet Insect voice and let them share the space.
water.extra: A low level makes a family quiet. A lower Activity setting makes it less likely to speak. Those are useful, different ways to leave room.
water.label: Water
